CSC FOLLOWSPOT F1 - pivots and axes (metres, as drawn in Minecraft = model x 1.50; Minecraft / glTF frame: Y up, front -Z)
base:  origin = bottom centre of the base (standing fixture); hung under a truss the whole fixture is turned 180 degrees about Z
yoke:  pan pivot (-0.0000, 1.8300, 0.0000), pan = rotation about +Y, 0 degrees in total (DMX centre = straight ahead)
head:  tilt pivot (-0.0000, 2.1900, 0.0000) (in the base frame), tilt = rotation about +X, 0 degrees in total, positive raises the beam; head OBJ vertices are relative to this pivot
beam:  origin (-0.0000, 0.0000, -1.2000) (head frame), axis (0.0000, 0.0000, -1.0000), lens radius 0.1200, zoom 3-20 degrees
